about: A self-hosted app for keeping track of paid subscriptions and what they cost.

prs.title: The API accepts the JSON examples from its own guide
prs.broken: The guide's examples for adding and changing a subscription through the API did not work. Adding stored a blank entry and changing did nothing, while both reported success.
prs.changed: Those two calls now accept JSON as well as form data, and bad JSON gets a clear error.
prs.matters: Scripts written from the guide add and update subscriptions as expected.

prs.title: Restored backups keep the right tags
prs.broken: Restoring a backup linked tags by their old number, so a subscription tagged "work" could come back tagged "personal", or lose its tag, while the app said all was fine.
prs.changed: Tags are now matched by name after each subscription is restored, as copying a subscription already did.
prs.matters: Restoring into an app that already has tags keeps every subscription sorted as before.
